title: Simple Web Scraper
prompt:
Write a program that scrapes a simple website and extracts relevant information.
Sample Output: The title of the webpage is: Example Webpage
answer:
Sure, I can help you with that. Here's an example Python program using the `requests` library to scrape a simple website and extract the title. Make sure you have the `requests` library installed by running `pip install requests`.

```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

# Replace 'https://example.com' with the URL of the webpage you want to scrape
url = 'https://example.com'

# Send a GET request to the webpage
response = requests.get(url)

# Parse the HTML content
soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')

# Find the title element
title = soup.title

# Extract the title text
title_text = title.string

# Print the result
print(f"The title of the webpage is: {title_text}")
```

This program sends a GET request to the specified URL, parses the HTML content using BeautifulSoup, and then finds the `<title>` element. The `string` attribute of the `<title>` element contains the title text, which is then printed to the console.

Please replace `'https://example.com'` with the actual URL of the webpage you want to scrape.
